group: ray-finned fishes: Characiformes radiation (Burns & Sidlauskas 2019 Evolution: 1,625 specimens, 128 species on trees_final.nexus; 24-LM body shape)

data.landmarks: Burns MD & Sidlauskas BL 2019 Evolution 73:569-587; Dryad/Zenodo 4988906 (`Chapter 1_Disparity Data.TPS`: 24 2D landmarks across 1,625 specimens and 263 species).

what_thompson_specifically_adds: Tests whether an ancient (~110 Myr) continental freshwater radiation of Otophysi (tetras, piranhas, headstanders, hatchetfishes, wolf-fishes) exhibits the same ~58% Thompson-7 variance share and within-clade phylogenetic predictability as marine acanthomorphs.

hypotheses.statement: Across the 128 Characiformes tree species (24 2D landmarks), Thompson-7 captures > 55% of between-species Procrustes variance.
hypotheses.reasoning: Characiform body plans span fusiform darters (`Characidium`) to deep-bodied rhomboid serrasalmids and anostomids along the classic Thompson dorsoventral/shear axes.

hypotheses.statement: Phylogenetic signal on `trees_final.nexus` is strong: Pagel's lambda > 0.7 (best model != White Noise) in both Thompson-7 and full PCA-95% spaces.
hypotheses.reasoning: Characiform families (Crenuchidae, Curimatidae, Anostomidae, Characidae) occupy distinct, conserved regions of morphospace.

hypotheses.statement: Leave-one-species-out phylogenetic prediction on `trees_final.nexus` beats the grand consensus (median Procrustes RMS ratio < 0.75, paired one-sided Wilcoxon p < 1e-8).
hypotheses.reasoning: Within-clade conditional prediction across 128 characiform species leverages family-level and genus-level body-plan conservatism.

hypotheses.statement: Head/eye/opercle interior landmarks have a higher unexplained residual fraction after Thompson-7 than the outer dorsal/ventral/caudal body contour landmarks.
hypotheses.reasoning: As in Claverie reef fishes, the outer body contour deforms smoothly under Thompson-7 while internal head/eye/jaw landmarks shift locally with trophic niche.
